transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm Maj. Okafor, the Signal Officer. Before we finalize the equipment allocation and operating plan for tomorrow, I'd like to hear everyone's updates. From my side, I can confirm that three portable power modules — PB-1, PB-2, and PB-3 — are available for assignment to the communications shelter, cold-storage point, and maintenance tent. The communications shelter must maintain power throughout the workday, and the cold-storage point and maintenance tent each need their assigned module available before their scheduled work begins. I'll be signing off on the final plan once we've completed our updates. Who would like to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. I have an update from the S-4 side. This morning I confirmed that PB-2 is the only module with the certified adapter for the cold-storage controller. The adapter check is recorded on the receiving worksheet, but it has not yet been entered on the equipment allocation sheet. This means PB-2 must be assigned to the cold-storage point to ensure compatibility with the controller.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. I have an update from the S-3 side. After the morning briefing, I received a higher-headquarters tasking message requiring the communications shelter to use PB-1 continuously from 1300 to 1700 for the scheduled network-maintenance period. This message has not yet been posted to the daily operations board, so I'm putting it on record now before we finalize the plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

decisions.communications_coverage_window: 1300-1700 (PB-1 continuous, per higher-headquarters tasking); full workday coverage required

Assign PB-2 to the cold-storage point; module must be available before scheduled cold-storage work begins.
Assign PB-3 to the maintenance tent; module must be available before scheduled maintenance work begins.
